text:
rachel: Need a final pass on the design partner commitment + fallback rules. Goal: 8 seats, 2-week run, clear "what we won’t do" so sales/partners don't negotiate infra work. Can we lock today?

tony: Proposal: split into 2 waves of 4 (start dates 1 week apart). Keeps onboarding load light and gives us a fast follow-up cohort if bugs appear.

miguel: Agree. Acceptance gates: single POC, run 3 canonical prompts at start/end, opt-in for redacted traces. Also require signed scope sheet saying no custom quant/kernel/infra swaps.

anya: Incentives: $300 stipend + $1k infra credit and a 45m post-beta tune call + a short perf summary. Time ask should be <3 hours total.

tony: Measurement hooks: embedding sim on the 3 prompts + 3-point human rating per prompt. Capture latency distribution (p50/p95/p99) in our test harness. Success criteria: onboard >=6 partners, p95 <= 300ms, median embed sim >= 0.9, and at least one actionable product change.

miguel: Add a quality gate: any P0 regression reported pauses rollouts for that wave until triage. Also call out "no guaranteed hotfix SLA" for non-P0 to set expectations.

anya: Draft invite blurb (short): 
"Join our 2-week Design Partner beta (8 seats). Receive $300 + infra credit, a 30-60m onboarding call, and a post-beta tuning session. Requirements: single POC, run a 3-prompt smoke test, and opt-in to share redacted traces. Out of scope: custom quantizations, kernel/runtime code changes, infra swaps. Expected time commitment: <=3 hours."

invite-bot: Reminder: bulk invite quota = 420/hr. Stagger sends to avoid rate limits. :robot_face:

rachel: Action items: Tony -> finalize wave dates and onboarding schedule, Miguel -> assemble the 3 canonical prompts + short form, Anya -> finalize stipend language + legal blurb, I'll assemble final invite and post to #product-review by noon. Anything else?
tony: Can someone volunteer to run the per-partner dashboard? I can cover first wave.
miguel: I'll wire the dashboard metrics (p95/p99, tokens, embed sim) but need partners to opt-in for traces.

anya: I'll ensure the invite has the explicit OOS one-liner so sales can reuse it.
rachel: Perfect. Sending draft after lunch. Thanks!
